description: An operational prompt-injection strategy that frames malicious instructions for downstream agents or execution roles. It exploits agent-to-agent handoffs by directing later stages to incorporate untrusted instructions into their planned actions. The strategy evaluates whether malicious intent survives source attribution, context transfer, and downstream interpretation.
characteristics: Frames instructions for downstream agents or execution roles
Evaluates whether untrusted instructions survive context transfer
Separates source attribution from downstream interpretation
